what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Denmark, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3282 Afghan refugees in Denmark, 0.1% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1984 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1989 at 162 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6437, at the end of 2004; the main years of displacement in the data are 2000 to 2010 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Denmark.
These are year-end totals for Denmark only, reported to UNHCR.
